scripts.build: rimraf public && npm run -s og-image && npm run -s deck
scripts.deck: node ../../scripts/marp-with-git-sha.mjs PITCHME.md --output public/index.html && ncp assets public/assets && node ../../scripts/inject-ga.mjs public/index.html
scripts.export-all: node ../../scripts/marp-with-git-sha.mjs PITCHME.md --output PITCHME.html && node ../../scripts/marp-with-git-sha.mjs PITCHME.md --output PITCHME.pdf && node ../../scripts/marp-with-git-sha.mjs PITCHME.md --output PITCHME.png && node ../../scripts/marp-with-git-sha.mjs PITCHME.md --output PITCHME.jpeg
scripts.vercel-build: yum install nss mesa-libgbm -y && MARP_USER=root CHROME_PATH=$(npx -y @puppeteer/browsers@latest install chrome@stable --path $(realpath ./tmp) | awk '{print $2}') npm run build
